build_detection_train_loader: build a training dataloader for coco_2017_train with batch size 16 and 4 workers
build_detection_test_loader: build a test dataloader for coco_2017_val with 4 workers and no empty filtering
get_detection_dataset_dicts: get detection dataset dicts for coco_2017_train or coco_2017_val splits
configure_DatasetMapper: configure a DatasetMapper with BGR format, instance masks, resize, and random flip augmentations
configure_COCOEvaluator: configure a COCOEvaluator for the coco_2017_val dataset using LazyCall
